issue.title: TUI first-paint footprint guard is red: eager artifact-link store imports put chop-only code on the startup path
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1uu.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2, epic sase-1uu). That phase blamed host load. The sase-1uu land agent re-ran the node in isolation on master 333f244b50 and found a deterministic source-footprint overrun, not a CPU or timing flake:

```
AssertionError: TUI app import loads 11,905,892 normalized source bytes from 2791 sase.* modules against the 11,896,376 cap
```

## Attribution (`.venv/bin/python tools/tui_import_closure --diff <rev>`)

- Pre-epic tree dfc0866360 already measures 11,897,750 bytes, 1,374 over the cap, so the guard was red before sase-1uu landed.
- da2165b80f (sase-1ut land, gate-turn) adds +3,996: `sase.core.agent_scan_wire_agent_session_turn` +3,573, `sase.notifications.store` +233, `_compact_meta_enrichment` / `_meta_enrichment_wire` +82 each, `sase.notifications.models` +26.
- Epic sase-1uu (63e52a856e, 555e30d832) adds +4,146: `sase.sdd._artifact_link_event_store` +1,520, new module `sase.sdd._artifact_link_snapshot_memo` +1,349, `_artifact_link_store_aggregate` +805, `_artifact_link_store_reconcile` +299, `_artifact_link_store_rows` +173. None of this code runs at TUI first paint. It is snapshot memoization and deadline-gated aggregate writes used by publication and backfill chops.

## Root cause and suggested fix

The TUI first-paint closure eagerly imports the whole artifact-link store stack through the `sase.sdd.artifact_link_store` facade. That stack is 24 `sase.sdd` artifact-link modules, about 130,343 footprint bytes. So any growth in store internals, such as sase-1uu's chop-only code, counts against the first-paint budget. Module-level importers of `sase.sdd.artifact_link_store` in the closure:

- `sase.ace.tui._artifact_link_contract`: only needs `assembled_artifact_relations`, which lives in the light `sase.sdd._artifact_link_store_support`.
- `sase.ace.query_profile.profiles._agents`
- `sase.sdd.artifact_link_neighborhood`
- `sase.artifact_ref_prompt_rendering`
- `sase.ace.tui.relations.artifact_links`
- `sase.ace.tui.actions.artifacts_link`

Defer these edges with use-site or `TYPE_CHECKING` imports, or point them at the light support module. Then re-measure, add `sase.sdd._artifact_link_store_impl` (or the facade) to `_DEFERRED_MODULES` if it drops out, and follow the ratchet policy comment in `tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py`. Never raise the cap for this chop-only code.

## Repro

```bash
.venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py::test_tui_app_import_stays_under_startup_budget -q
.venv/bin/python tools/tui_import_closure --diff dfc0866360
```

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The footprint is a static measurement of normalized source bytes in the import closure, so it does not vary with load. It fails identically in isolation on 333f244b50 (11,905,892 >= 11,896,376), and `tools/tui_import_closure --diff` attributes every byte above the cap to named commits.

issue.creation_reason: The TUI first-paint footprint guard fails deterministically on master, and phase sase-1uu.2 misreported it as host load. The guard was already red before epic sase-1uu, and both sase-1ut and sase-1uu then added chop-only artifact-link and gate-turn bytes to the closure.
